name: Environment Indicator Header
description: Display environment indicator version in header.
project_description: Environment Indicator Header adds a missing feature to the Environment Indicator module: it emits the current release string in an HTTP response header. A response event subscriber sets a 'Release' header on every response whose value is read from the 'environment_indicator.current_release' Drupal state key (populated by Environment Indicator, e.g. via 'drush state:set environment_indicator.current_release v1.2.44'). The module has no configuration UI, routes, permissions or config objects; it depends on the environment_indicator module.
